learning_outcomes.text: Will design and calculate reinforced concrete structures and their foundations.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to the design of reinforced concrete structures
Safety, design situations and calculation bases
Calculation hypotheses according to limit states
Design and provisions for beams and columns
Computer-aided calculation of industrial buildings and various reinforced concrete elements
assessment_rules: For part-time students recognized by the university, non-recoverable assessment activities will be replaced by equivalent ones if the reason for non-completion is the same as the reason for their part-time status. There are no critical criteria explicitly stated for passing the course.
